name: Cinder Beetle
telegraph: Furnace mouth and hot wing-case seam indicate fire. Stops before firing a small ember.
counterplay: One slow straight shot; use rocks or sidestep. No boss ring or persistent fire field.
projectile: Small ember; intended to use the existing procedural voxel-fire style.
notes: Suggested tuning only. Not an EnemyDef or spawn registration; gameplay unchanged. Projectile VOX is a visual concept; runtime uses procedural meshes.
